channel.title: Colorado Public Radio - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Colorado Public Radio (cpr.org)

item.title: The Colorado Symphony just played 3 sold-out shows in New York. They hope their home state takes note
item.description: The concerts were with Boulder singer-songwriter Gregory Alan Isakov and Grammy winner Itzhak Perlman.

item.title: Colorado and coalition strike a deal with drug companies accused of price-fixing
item.description: The settlement totals to $17.85 million for patients who bought specific generic drugs from 2009 to 2019 and administrative costs.

item.title: ‘Somos familia’: Ken Salazar on the Treaty of Guadalupe Hidalgo and borderlands history in Colorado
item.description: In a conversation at History Colorado, the former U.S. senator and ambassador connects the treaty’s legacy to modern border debates.

item.title: As Venezuela’s future remains uncertain, its symphony orchestra reaches a new milestone
item.description: The Simón Bolívar Symphony Orchestra's recording of Ravel's Boléro is up for a Grammy nomination for best orchestral performance. The recognition comes at a turbulent moment for Venezuela, but the orchestra remains focused on the music.

item.title: Colorado’s ‘first public Christian school’ closes building to address officials’ safety concerns
item.description: It’s not clear if Riverstone is still providing instruction to students.

item.title: Despite torn ACL, Lindsey Vonn will try to race in Olympics
item.description: The 41-year-old Vail skier keeps hope alive for a stunning comeback.

item.title: What a swing House district in Colorado shows about Republicans’ immigration fallout in the midterms
item.description: President Donald Trump's immigration crackdown in Minnesota is rattling voters in a highly competitive swing district in northern Colorado.

item.title: State responds to major avian flu outbreak in Weld County
item.description: The Department of Ag will cull over one million birds after the virus was detected last week.

item.title: A male wolf died during a capture and collaring operation in northwest Colorado
item.description: Out of the 25 wolves brought to Colorado, only 13 survive.

item.title: Family of a man shot and killed by a Douglas County Sheriff’s Deputy files wrongful death lawsuit
item.description: Jalin Seabron was celebrating his birthday when Douglas County Sheriff’s Deputy Nicholas Moore showed up for a separate shooting involving a female suspect.
